newsitem.title: USA: CNL buys out Conolog bank debt.
newsitem.headline: CNL buys out Conolog bank debt.

text.p: Conolog Corp said Monday that it has agreed for CNL Holdings Inc to purchase $1.025 million of its debt from Chase Manhattan Bank, leaving Conolog debt-free.
The company said that CNL would also take over 375,000 shares of Conolog owned by the bank.
The debt is in the form of a note convertible to 1.4 million Conolog shares, said the company, and CNL is expected to convert the shares shortly.

The company added that CNL had given management the right, by proxy, to vote all 1.775 million shares it expects to own, and that CNL has given it assurances that it is entering into the transaction as an investment.
Conolog makes and sells electronic products and assemblies, including transducers, digital signal processing sytems, audio transmitters, receivers and modulators.
